newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - SAUDI NEWSPAPERS - JULY 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - SAUDI NEWSPAPERS - JULY 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan will hold talks on Sunday with the French Defence Minister Alain Richard on military and defence cooperation between the two countries.
- Saudi Consolidated Electricity Company in the Central Province (SCECO-Central) allocates 1.274 billion riyals for various electricity projects this year.
- Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam chambers of commerce consider standardization of fees collected for approval of re-export deals.
- Gulf Cooperation Council states seek to ban smoking in public areas.
- Riyad Bank offers 600 jobs to Saudis this year.
- Work on the King Fahd reservoir in Asir ends.
- Arab Investment Company posts $27.7 million net profit, up from $18.4 million a year earlier.
